results.title: Critical review with independent reputation hold
recommendedActions: Apply reputation changes with normal audit logging.

results.title: Author-affiliated penalties after rejection recommendation

findings.message: An author-affiliated actor applied a punitive reputation action shortly after a critical review.
findings.remediation: Freeze the reputation delta and route the action to an independent moderator before publication or profile export.

findings.message: An author-affiliated actor applied a punitive reputation action shortly after a critical review.
findings.remediation: Freeze the reputation delta and route the action to an independent moderator before publication or profile export.

findings.message: Multiple affiliated actors targeted the same reviewer within the retaliation window.
findings.remediation: Escalate as a retaliation cluster, suspend automated scoring, and require independent adjudication.

findings.message: A public-facing badge, endorsement, role, or visibility signal was reduced after an unfavorable review.
findings.remediation: Hold public profile updates until the action is justified by evidence unrelated to the review outcome.

findings.message: The packet has retaliation risk but no independent moderator review recorded.
findings.remediation: Add independent moderator signoff before applying the reputation change.

findings.message: The reviewer has insufficient time to appeal a reputation-impacting action.
findings.remediation: Provide at least a 14-day appeal window and show the evidence packet to the affected reviewer.

findings.message: Public reputation export is enabled while unresolved retaliation risk exists.
findings.remediation: Freeze the public export and leaderboard deltas until the retaliation review is resolved.

recommendedActions: Disable leaderboard and public profile export for the affected reviewer until resolution.
Freeze reputation deltas tied to the flagged review.
Generate an evidence packet for an independent moderator.
Notify the affected reviewer of the appeal pathway.

findings.message: A reputation event contains language that appears to pressure the reviewer to soften or alter criticism.

evidence.excerpt: Unless you revise the review and remove the negative comment, your reputation will drop.

findings.remediation: Separate reputation handling from manuscript-review negotiation and preserve the message for moderator review.
